modules.label: Scheme semantic planner
modules.owns: Normalization, GVM semantic completion, effects, FrameSpec, PointId and primitive/FFI legality
modules.provides: Closed semantic plan and ordered module contract
modules.excludes: Does not choose execution scheduling or native resource ownership

modules.label: Modern generated C
modules.owns: Mechanical lowering and generated frame/root/layout/entry declarations from completed plan
modules.provides: C ABI, trampoline and exact layout adapters
modules.excludes: Does not invent a second Scheme semantic policy

modules.label: VM and execution admission
modules.owns: Execution grants, park/reentry, participant membership, resize and exit admission
modules.provides: Stable context identity with explicit join/leave and last-user closure
modules.excludes: A descriptor or published TLS pointer is not an execution grant

modules.label: Root and lifetime interface
modules.owns: Cross-owner root-cut, slot-update and last-reader agreement; execution/FFI remain value custodians, GC remains scanner
modules.provides: Epoch-bound root slots and scan grants with reload obligations
modules.excludes: Does not take semantic ownership away from producer and scanner modules

modules.label: Allocation and collection
modules.owns: Heap layout, allocation budgets, copy/scan tasks, phases, promotion and reclaim decisions
modules.provides: Complete work context with parent/child/Tail custody and phase closure
modules.excludes: Worker identity does not imply processor or native-thread identity

modules.label: Continuation and dynamic control
modules.owns: Captured/current/saved frame interpretation, denv mutation, restore and supported nonlocal exits
modules.provides: Root-complete frame traversal and resumption origins
modules.excludes: Gambit continuations are not silently restricted to one-shot effect resumptions

modules.label: Foreign entry and blocking
modules.owns: Borrow scopes, root protection before marker allocation, nested callback origin and acquired-effect cleanup
modules.provides: Admitted host entry, block transition and explicit result/control boundary
modules.excludes: Raw C pointers do not survive moving GC by language interoperability alone

modules.label: Resource release coordination
modules.owns: Classified release effects, thread-affine jobs, WaitContext, derived-task accounting and shutdown drain
modules.provides: Accepted task custody and exactly owned completion/result disposition
modules.excludes: A drained GC phase is not proof that external resources or borrowers drained

modules.label: Incremental build engine and artifact graph
modules.owns: Rule planning, dependencies, rebuild decision, CPU/memory scheduling and transactional artifact publication
modules.provides: Source/plan/generated/object/link lineage and effective multicore ABI
modules.excludes: Does not define Scheme unit semantics or count build threads as runtime processors

interfaces.failureCustody: Producer retains roots until accepted handoff; unknown outcome retains custody
interfaces.disposition: existing binding; full writer and weak-memory refinement open

interfaces.payload: FrameSpec identity, current/saved/captured origins, denv edges and supported mutation writers

interfaces.failureCustody: Opaque mutation uses explicitly sound scan fallback; uncovered bypass blocks scan exclusion

interfaces.payload: Exclusive execution grant, park acknowledgement, root-cut epoch and resumed-value reload

benefitCases.removedWork: Duplicated admission/result-disposition decisions across error, join and cleanup paths; runtime work savings not yet established
benefitCases.addedCost: Independent result/carrier, admission and last-use synchronization
benefitCases.positiveCondition: Lost admitted outcomes = 0; duplicate final release = 0; retained descriptors and exit latency bounded by declared users
benefitCases.refutation: If retained users never finish or memory grows without bound, safety alone does not establish positive benefit

benefitCases.removedWork: Separate implicit phase/exit custody interpretations replaced by one explicit work census; wait/scan savings remain conditional
benefitCases.addedCost: Context descriptors, census/epoch checks, handoff and accounting
benefitCases.positiveCondition: Accounted tasks = accepted outstanding work; compare rendezvous wait plus handoff cost under equal work
benefitCases.refutation: Added handoff/cache traffic may outweigh imbalance savings; forced single-processor execution is not a gain

benefitCases.removedWork: Lost-progress rescans and duplicated Tail/child dispatch in a proposed worker split
benefitCases.addedCost: Materialized subframes at admitted cuts, task IDs and retained source/destination regions
benefitCases.positiveCondition: One canonical initializer and one execution per owned Tail; measure descriptor bytes and stores per copied live word
benefitCases.refutation: Do not count a hypothetical migration defect as existing baseline overhead; per-word materialization may be unjustified

benefitCases.removedWork: Duplicated callback root protection, owner restore and cleanup plans
benefitCases.addedCost: Root slots, grants, publication/reload, nested-entry checks
benefitCases.positiveCondition: All legal entry roots protected before allocating; enumerate publications and entry/park overhead
benefitCases.refutation: Raw untracked mutation or callback escape prevents fast-path admission; slower sound handling remains necessary

benefitCases.removedWork: Repeated inline blocking and ad hoc shutdown rescans across resource producers
benefitCases.addedCost: Release queues, WaitContext synchronization, rooted payload retention and descendant counts
benefitCases.positiveCondition: Accepted = queued + running + completed/disposed; compare GC pause reduction against queue/retention costs
benefitCases.refutation: Moving work later does not remove total release work; external thread affinity or unbounded blocking can defeat gain

benefitCases.removedWork: Duplicated frame/root/return-label decisions and unnecessary mature continuation traversal
benefitCases.addedCost: Generated metadata, safepoint spill/reload and barrier/remembered scans
benefitCases.positiveCondition: One semantic owner per decision; avoided mature visits exceed writes/logs/revisits/promotion costs
benefitCases.refutation: Opaque mutation or incomplete origins forbids skipping graph scan; one-shot restriction is not equivalent Gambit support

benefitCases.removedWork: Repeated full planning and over-broad rebuilds; nested CPU oversubscription
benefitCases.addedCost: Input hashing, memo invalidation, dependency records and shared CPU/memory tokens
benefitCases.positiveCondition: No-op eligible native actions = 0; active token demand <= host grant; exact affected graph for each declared delta
benefitCases.refutation: Hash/planner cost can dominate small builds; keys excluding real inputs are invalid speedups

benefitCases.removedWork: Redundant Scheme-to-C generation, unchanged downstream C compilation and manual linkage synchronization
benefitCases.addedCost: Plan/action manifest and output digests; ABI/schema invalidation; staging publication
benefitCases.positiveCondition: Identical valid output cuts off descendants; relink ordered closure only when its inputs change
benefitCases.refutation: Bootstrap stages using different compilers or dynamic semantic effects cannot share merely by source filename
